title: Detect Legacy Storage
description: An operator needs to know whether a deployed contract predates storage versioning. The schema version lives in instance storage, and a missing entry is defined to mean version 0.

content.prompt:
Fill in the storage key so a missing entry safely falls back to version 0 instead of panicking.

let version: u32 = env
    .storage()
    .instance()
    .get(&DataKey::???)
    .unwrap_or(0);

hint: The contract writes its current schema version during `init` under a dedicated `DataKey` variant and exposes it through `get_schema_version`. A deployment that predates versioning has no such entry, so the reader must default to 0 rather than treat absence as an error. Never reuse this key for a different meaning.
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Admin key has a different meaning
Question count is not a schema marker
Version is a dedicated key, not a level plan
